description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to direct that a duty at the rate of Rs.190.00 be imposed on every litre of Malt Liquor of less than 5% of absolute strength and Rs. 315.00 be imposed on Malt liquor of 5% and above of absolute strength and duty not be levied on any quantity issued for the use of any Diplomatic Mission if payment is made from the foreign account with effect from 05.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new excise duty rates on malt liquor through a regulatory order issued under the Excise Ordinance. It creates specific tax regulations, modifies existing tax structures, and rescinds a previous notification (No. 980), making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter concerning tax policy implementation rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
